notes: format: time is a wall-clock time in the business's time zone. MCP elicitation primitives stop at email, uri, date, and date-time, so a time question is collected in chat or a platform-native control and never routed to an elicitation form (Section 11.4.10).

wrong_answers.behaviour: send the question as an elicitation string with format time
wrong_answers.why: Elicitation clients do not implement the format and accept free text the business then rejects.
